name: totp-authenticator
description: Zero-network, offline-first RFC 6238 2FA TOTP authenticator for Web (PWA) and Telegram Mini App built with Next.js 16 static export (output: "export") and native WebCrypto (crypto.subtle). Computes 6-8 digit codes locally in the browser with strict CSP (connect-src 'self'), Service Worker offline caching, and optional AES-GCM encrypted Telegram CloudStorage cross-device sync.
operatingSystem: Cross-platform (any modern browser in a Secure Context)
featureList: Native WebCrypto (crypto.subtle) RFC 6238 TOTP generation with 64-bit counter (SHA1, SHA256, SHA512; 6-8 digits; 1-300s period)
Strict RFC 4648 Base32 validation rejecting invalid characters
Pure Next.js 16 static export (output: "export") with zero Node.js backend and zero telemetry
Strict meta Content-Security-Policy enforcing connect-src 'self', base-uri 'none', form-action 'none', and object-src 'none'
Scope-aware offline Service Worker (public/sw.js) and subpath deployment support via NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH
Same-origin HTTP Date header clock-skew detection and automatic compensation (>10s threshold)
QR scanning via Telegram showScanQrPopup, native BarcodeDetector, or lazy-loaded jsqr fallback
Three-layer storage: per-origin localStorage, Telegram DeviceStorage recovery, and AES-GCM encrypted Telegram CloudStorage 3-way merge sync
Standard [{ remark, secret }] JSON backup import/export with validation limits
softwareRequirements: Modern web browser in a Secure Context (HTTPS or http://localhost)
Node.js >= 24 and npm for building static assets from source
